$comment: Accepted disagreements between the ledger and an external source. A difference only counts as known while BOTH expected and actual still equal the values below, so any change forces a fresh review.

differences.reason: RSSSF list (last updated 7 Oct 2026) ends at cap 233 on 6 Jul 2026 and omits the 24 Sep 2026 Nations League appearance vs Wales (see data/manual/international-appearances-extra.csv).

Wikipedia's lead says 141 international wins, which equals RSSSF's 141 over 233 caps. The 234th cap (Portugal 1-0 Wales, 24 Sep 2026) was a win, so the lead appears not to have been updated. Shootouts are counted as draws.

enwiki counts 2 Segunda Divisão B appearances for Sporting CP B in 2002-03 (0 goals). eswiki's match table omits them and sources disagree on the dates and opponents, so the ledger has no match rows for them. Listed in the M3 gap list.

The 2 Sporting CP B reserve-team appearances (see the sporting-cp-b check). Every first-team season and competition matches enwiki exactly. Per decision (b), the published club appearance figure is the ledger's 1,107.

Kaggle dates Tottenham 0-4 Man Utd as 3 Feb 2007. It was played on Sunday 4 Feb 2007 (season article; Premier League, BBC and ESPN match pages). The ledger keeps 4 Feb and the ingest matches Kaggle's row to it with a one-day tolerance.
